records.text: The viewer using the handle Earl’s daughter reported a mother’s account that an unnamed pediatrician advised keeping her child’s Asperger diagnosis out of medical records because it would put a target on his back; the nested speakers and child’s identity are unverified.
records.speaker: Earl's daughter (viewer handle; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Earl's daughter (viewer handle as transcribed) writes, I had a convo with some moms years ago. One said her son was John (as transcribed; child in viewer anecdote, full identity unverified), was diagnosed with Asperger. She took the results to his pediatrician who said the best thing she could do is never put it in his medical records. ... The doc said it would put a target on his back. Wow, that is mind blowing. And I have to say, I totally believe it.
